category: hosted secrets management with config sync to deployment targets (SaaS; on-premises only on Enterprise)

free_tier.stated: Team plan: free for 14 days, then USD 21/mo per user; 90 Days of activity logs, 100 config syncs, 250 projects, 15 environments, 500 service tokens, SAML SSO, Role-Based Access Controls, automatic secret rotation and service accounts
free_tier.notes: Team is a 14-day trial followed by a per-human-seat charge; the bill counts human users, and the pricing page says AI agents and non-human identities ride free. The Developer plan above it is free for 3 users and USD 8/mo per additional user. USD 21 is the first paid tier with SSO and RBAC.

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: the pricing and API pages state no size limit per secret; Doppler documents multi-line secrets such as PEM and SSH keys

retention.stated: Activity log retention is 90 days on Team, Custom on Enterprise; no expiry for stored secrets is stated on the pages read
retention.notes: The 90-day value applies to activity logs, not to secret values. No automatic expiry of stored secrets is stated on the pages read.

egress.terms: not applicable: a secrets management API; the pricing page names no traffic allowance or per-GB charge, and the API is reached over HTTPS at api.doppler.com

interface_detail: The Doppler API is organized around REST with predictable resource-oriented URLs, JSON request bodies and responses, and bearer-token authentication; base URL api.doppler.com. The open-source Doppler CLI injects secrets into a process with doppler run and reads values with doppler secrets get.
tooling: the Doppler CLI, the REST API at api.doppler.com, official SDKs, the MCP server and the web dashboard
chaining: Secrets are delivered to apps and CI through the CLI, REST API, config syncs to deployment targets, and service tokens scoped to a single config.

limits.value: Team: 480 Reads/min, 240 Secret reads/min and 120 Writes/min per IP address; a further rate limit is tied to the API key
500 users, 250 projects, 15 environments, 500 service tokens and 100 config syncs on Team
90 days of activity logs on Team
Add-ons on Team cost USD 9 per seat per month each for custom roles, user groups, or raising config syncs from 100 to 500; dynamic secrets, SCIM and on-premises need Enterprise

binding_note: The per-IP rate limits apply to every API and CLI read; a workload pulling secrets through one CI address meets 480 Reads/min before the 500-user or 100-sync quotas are reached.

identity_cost.detail: The sign-up page for the Developer plan says Create an account using one of the following options and offers Google, GitHub, Secure SSO or Email; no card, phone number or ID document is asked for on the sign-up page. The Team plan is a 14-day trial and the pricing page does not show whether a card is required to start it. Fields shown only after account creation are unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: The API answers 429 when a rate limit is hit and sends x-ratelimit-limit, x-ratelimit-remaining, x-ratelimit-reset and retry-after headers; no data-loss event is stated on the pages read.
confidence_note: Plan limits, the rate-limit table and the sign-up fields are quoted from first-party Doppler pricing, API reference and registration pages. No account, trial or payment was created; any value visible only after registration is unverified.
